# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b76 — Compact room and device card

Beta76 builds directly on Beta75. This release is strictly a **Lovelace card presentation update**, with no changes to physical controllers, PID, relay ownership, compressor minimum ON/OFF durations, window/sleep policy, HA storage, WAQI/AQI scale recognition, or cover solar-shading logic.

## Less space, same information

- **Room climate:** Current temperature and humidity remain equally prominent in smaller side-by-side tiles. The verbose always-visible explanations below them are consolidated behind a small, accessible, expandable **information icon**.
- **Room-state chips:** Show effective profile and verified occupancy, sleeping state, selected room-window condition, and an actual hold/error when known. No unavailable sensor is represented as verified CLOSED or occupied. Only already available room-plan/status/source data are used.
- **Managed devices:** Measurements and targets now use a dense, responsive mini-grid: shorter one-line labels/values and smaller spacing. Complete untruncated values are retained in each tile's native hover title and the device **information icon** disclosure, including on touch devices.
- **Device status:** A compact icon/chip row replaces long explanatory text for controller status, power-supply state, sleep pause and selected window safety. The original friendly names and reasons remain accessible by opening the info icon or Diagnostics.
- **Window protection switch:** Retains its exact existing control, accessible label and disabled-state guards; it is simply styled more compactly. Its 60-second actual window-close hold and the hardware protections are unchanged.
- **Diagnostics and PID calibration:** Remain collapsed by default and keep their click/keyboard/touch expansion across live state refreshes. Technical identifiers remain behind the existing nested disclosure.
- **Overall density:** Reduce room padding, section gaps, main header spacing, large measurement cards and climate/device panel margins, keeping temperature/RH legible on desktop and mobile.
- **Localization:** Reuse the existing translated climate/device strings, status messages and window labels across all 38 shipped language catalogs. Do not create a second set of backend state names.

## Safety and responsiveness

This update adds **no new Home Assistant subscriptions, entity rescans, timers, backend services, physical commands or device settings**. Existing Beta68 batched rendering and indexed managed-device status are reused. All contextual HTML is escaped and each new info disclosure uses Beta66's existing event-delegated, persistent, accessible details mechanism.

## Validation

CI executes real Chromium browser tests for:
- compact room and device data with short tiles even when Greek names/values are long;
- fully readable original readings behind information icons, one-click expansion across rapid rerenders and keyboard access;
- live bedroom occupancy/sleep/window-warning badges, window-policy switch preserved;
- responsive widths **320 / 375 / 430 / 590 pixels** with no page horizontal overflow;
- retained original device diagnostics, PID calibration, AQI messages and all 38 supported locales;
- Home Assistant event-stream and 5,000-entity burst rendering behavior without extra physical service calls.

The publisher also runs Beta61–75 core controller, supply, PID, window, sleep, AQI and shade regressions. Live installation on every dashboard theme/device remains to be verified.

## Installation

In **HACS → Home Environment Manager**, enable beta versions, select **v0.6.0b76**, and install on the existing integration. After the usual Home Assistant restart, **hard-reload the dashboard tab** so it picks up the new JavaScript card. Do not add a second integration. The manual ZIP contains the canonical custom_components/environment_manager/ folder.
